name: escarlet-local-ai-ui
description: Private web UI for local LM Studio and Ollama models.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @escarlet-local-ai-ui/server" "npm run dev --workspace @escarlet-local-ai-ui/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @escarlet-local-ai-ui/web && npm run build --workspace @escarlet-local-ai-ui/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @escarlet-local-ai-ui/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @escarlet-local-ai-ui/web
